title: ARGUS paper-to-broker calibration transfer audit verified
summary: ARGUS now supports a prospectively registered transfer-compatibility audit that compares ICARUS paper-emulator impact calibration with broker-confirmed calibration without pooling or relabeling the evidence classes. The plan content-addresses the exact study, metric set, tolerances, confidence alpha, deterministic seed, replicate count and minimum observations before the cohort begins. Each metric reports paper-minus-broker with a deterministic two-sample percentile interval and is within tolerance only when the full interval lies inside its predeclared bound.
evidence: exact-head subsystem-evolution workflow run 36942637761 completed success
